     1→<!DOCTYPE html>
     2→<html lang="en">
     3→<head>
     4→<meta charset="UTF-8">
     5→<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
     6→<title>PlugPay — The trust layer for Kenya's WhatsApp commerce</title>
     7→<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
     8→<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
     9→<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo+Black&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=DM+Mono:wght@500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    10→<style>
    11→:root{
    12→  --bg-dark:#080b1a;
    13→  --card-dark:#131730;
    14→  --card-dark2:#181d3a;
    15→  --card-border:rgba(255,255,255,.09);
    16→  --mint:#e557d6;
    17→  --mint-dark:#691460;
    18→  --ink:#0a0e1c;
    19→  --muted:#5b6178;
    20→  --muted-dark:rgba(255,255,255,.56);
    21→  --border:#e7e8ef;
    22→  --bg-light:#ffffff;
    23→  --red:#691460;
    24→  --fh:'Archivo Black',sans-serif;
    25→  --fb:'Inter',sans-serif;
    26→  --fm:'DM Mono',monospace;
    27→  --wrap:600px;
    28→}
    29→*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
    30→html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
    31→body{font-family:var(--fb);color:var(--ink);background:var(--bg-light);width:100%;overflow-x:hidden;line-height:1.65;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
    32→.wrap{max-width:var(--wrap);margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
    33→a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
    34→button{font-family:var(--fb)}
    35→img{max-width:100%;display:block}
    36→
    37→/* ---------- EYEBROW / HEADLINE PRIMITIVES ---------- */
    38→.eyebrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-family:var(--fm);font-size:10.5px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mint);margin-bottom:14px}
    39→.eyebrow::before{content:'';width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--mint);flex-shrink:0}
    40→.eyebrow.on-dark{color:var(--mint)}
    41→h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--fh);text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1.02;letter-spacing:-.5px}
    42→h2{font-size:clamp(30px,8vw,40px);margin-bottom:16px}
    43→.section-p{font-size:14.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.75;max-width:46ch}
    44→.on-dark .section-p{color:var(--muted-dark)}
    45→section{padding:64px 0;position:relative}
    46→
    47→/* ---------- NAV ---------- */
    48→.nav{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;background:var(--bg-dark);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
    49→.nav-inner{max-width:var(--wrap);margin:0 auto;padding:14px 20px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
    50→.nav-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}
    51→.logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-family:var(--fh);font-size:16px;color:#fff;letter-spacing:-.3px;flex-shrink:0}
    52→.pp-logo{font-family:var(--fh);letter-spacing:-.4px}
    53→.pp-logo .plug{color:#3457a6}
    54→.pp-logo .pay{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#ff8a3d,#e0508a);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;color:#e0508a}
    55→.pp-logo.on-white .plug{color:#3457a6}
    56→.logo-mark{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:7px;background:var(--mint);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:var(--fh);font-size:11px;color:var(--bg-dark);flex-shrink:0}
    57→.nav-links{display:none;gap:22px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:rgba(255,255,255,.75)}
    58→.nav-cta{background:var(--mint);color:var(--bg-dark);font-weight:700;font-size:12.5px;padding:9px 16px;border-radius:100px;white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0}
    59→.nav-search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:100px;padding:10px 15px}
    60→.nav-search svg{flex-shrink:0;opacity:.5}
    61→.nav-search input{flex:1;background:transparent;border:none;outline:none;color:#fff;font-size:12.5px;font-family:var(--fb);min-width:0}
    62→.nav-search input::placeholder{color:rgba(255,255,255,.4)}
    63→@media(min-width:760px){
    64→  .nav-inner{flex-direction:row;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
    65→  .nav-links{display:flex}
    66→  .nav-search{width:220px}
    67→}
    68→
    69→/* ---------- HERO ---------- */
    70→.hero{background:var(--bg-dark);color:#fff;padding:44px 0 24px}
    71→.hero-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);padding:6px 13px 6px 8px;border-radius:100px;margin-bottom:22px}
    72→.hero-dots{display:flex}
    73→.hero-dots span{width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--bg-dark);margin-left:-6px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:7px;font-weight:800;color:#fff}
    74→.hero-dots span:first-child{margin-left:0}
    75→.hero-badge b{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:rgba(255,255,255,.85)}
    76→.hero h1{color:#fff;font-size:clamp(34px,10vw,46px);margin-bottom:18px}
    77→.hero h1 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--mint)}
    78→.hero-p{font-size:12px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);max-width:42ch;margin-bottom:18px;line-height:1.7}
    79→.hero-note{font-size:12px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);line-height:1.7;margin-bottom:22px}
    80→.hero-rule{width:64px;height:3px;background:var(--mint);margin-bottom:14px}
    81→
    82→/* hero tabbed search bar (Find a merchant / Find a building) */
    83→.hero-search-wrap{margin-bottom:24px}
    84→.hero-search-box{background:#fff;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 22px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.35);max-width:506px}
    85→.hsb-tabs{display:flex;border-bottom:1px solid #eceef5}
    86→.hsb-tab{flex:1;text-align:center;padding:13px 10px;font-family:var(--fm);font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#8a8ca0;cursor:pointer;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;transition:all .15s}
    87→.hsb-tab.on{color:var(--bg-dark);border-bottom-color:var(--mint);background:#fafbfe}
    88→.hsb-input-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:13px 16px}
    89→.hsb-input-row svg{flex-shrink:0}
    90→.hsb-input-row input{flex:1;min-width:0;border:none;outline:none;font-size:13.5px;font-family:var(--fb);color:#2b2e42}
    91→.hsb-input-row input::placeholder{color:#aeb0c2}
    92→.hsb-btn{background:var(--bg-dark);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 18px;font-family:var(--fb);font-weight:800;font-size:12.5px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;transition:background .15s}
    93→.hsb-btn:hover{background:#000}
    94→
    95→/* hero live stats row */
    96→.hero-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,auto);gap:28px;margin-bottom:26px}
    97→.hstat{padding-right:28px;border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14)}
    98→.hstat:last-child{border-right:none;padding-right:0}
    99→.hstat-n{font-family:var(--fh);font-size:22px;font-weight:800;color:var(--mint);line-height:1}
   100→.hstat-l{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:9px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);margin-top:5px}
   101→
   102→/* phone/browser mockup */
   103→.hero-phone-shot{max-width:340px;margin:0 auto}
   104→.hero-phone-shot img{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;filter:drop-shadow(0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.5))}
   105→
   106→/* ---------- Scrollable WhatsApp demo phone ---------- */
   107→.wa-phone{max-width:300px;margin:0 auto;background:#ffffff;border-radius:34px;padding:2px;box-shadow:0 20px 46px rgba(0,0,0,.35);border:1px solid #e4e4e4}
   108→.wa-screen{background:#0b141a;border-radius:32px;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
   109→.wa-header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:12px 13px 10px;background:#1f2c34;cursor:pointer}
   110→.wa-avatar{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;background:#16b880;color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:800;font-size:11px;flex-shrink:0;font-family:var(--fb)}
   111→.wa-header-name{color:#fff;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700}
   112→.wa-header-status{color:#8696a0;font-size:10px}
   113→.wa-body{height:418px;overflow-y:auto;padding:13px 9px 6px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
   114→.wa-body::-webkit-scrollbar{width:4px}
   115→.wa-body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:4px}
   116→.wa-day{text-align:center}
   117→.wa-day span{background:#182229;color:#8696a0;font-size:9px;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:8px;font-family:var(--fm)}
   118→.wa-bubble-in{align-self:flex-start;background:#1f2c34;color:#e9edef;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:2px 9px 9px 9px;max-width:84%;font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.5}
   119→.wa-bubble-out{align-self:flex-end;background:#005c4b;color:#e9edef;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:9px 2px 9px 9px;max-width:84%;font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.5}
   120→.wa-time{display:block;text-align:right;font-size:8.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);margin-top:3px}
   121→.wa-check{color:#53bdeb;margin-left:3px;font-size:9px}
   122→.wa-sys{align-self:center;background:#182229;color:#c6cdd2;font-size:10.5px;padding:7px 11px;border-radius:9px;max-width:90%;text-align:center;line-height:1.5}
   123→.wa-card{display:block;align-self:flex-start;flex-shrink:0;background:#233741;border-radius:9px;overflow:hidden;width:90%;cursor:default;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
   124→.wa-card-h{display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:center;padding:10px 11px 8px;color:#fff;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700}
   125→.wa-card-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 11px;font-size:10.5px;color:#c6cdd2;margin-bottom:6px}
   126→.wa-card-row.total{font-weight:800;color:#fff;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);padding-top:7px;margin-top:1px}
   127→.wa-card-note{padding:2px 11px 10px;font-size:10px;color:#8696a0;line-height:1.5}
   128→.wa-card-sent{padding:0 11px 8px;font-size:9px;color:#5b6b74}
   129→.wa-card-btn{display:block;text-align:center;padding:10px;color:#53bdeb;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);cursor:pointer;background:none;width:100%;border-left:none;border-right:none;border-bottom:none}
   130→.wa-card-badge{margin:0 11px 10px;background:rgba(37,211,102,.15);color:#25d366;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:6px}
   131→.wa-stars{color:#ffb648;font-size:11px;padding:0 11px;margin-bottom:8px}
   132→.wa-quick{display:flex;flex-direction:column;width:90%;align-self:flex-start;gap:0}
   133→.wa-quick-btn{background:#1f2c34;color:#53bdeb;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;padding:10px 11px;border-radius:8px;margin-top:2px;cursor:pointer;border:none;text-align:left;width:100%}
   134→.wa-scroll-hint{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:26px;background:linear-gradient(rgba(11,20,26,0),#0b141a);pointer-events:none}
   135→.wa-caption{text-align:center;font-family:var(--fm);font-size:10px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);margin-top:12px;letter-spacing:.02em}
   136→.mock{background:#fff;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 30px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}
   137→.mock-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 14px;background:#f1f2f6;border-bottom:1px solid #e4e5ee}
   138→.mock-dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#d7d8e2}
   139→.mock-url{flex:1;background:#fff;border:1px solid #e4e5ee;border-radius:6px;padding:4px 10px;font-family:var(--fm);font-size:9.5px;color:#666;margin-left:4px}
   140→.mock-body{padding:16px;background:#fafbfe}
   141→.mock-vault{background:var(--bg-dark);border-radius:12px;padding:16px 16px 14px;color:#fff;margin-bottom:14px}
   142→.mock-vault-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:4px}
   143→.mock-vault-top span{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);text-transform:uppercase}
   144→.mock-vault-badge{background:rgba(105,20,96,.15);color:var(--mint);font-size:9px;font-weight:700;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:100px;font-family:var(--fm)}
   145→.mock-amt{font-family:var(--fh);font-size:26px}
   146→.mock-sub{font-size:11px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);margin-top:2px}
   147→.mock-list-h{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-family:var(--fm);font-size:9px;color:#9ea0b3;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;margin-bottom:8px}
   148→.mock-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:9px 0;border-top:1px solid #eceef5}
   149→.mock-row-id{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:11px;color:#2b2e42}
   150→.mock-row-loc{font-size:9.5px;color:#8a8ca0}
   151→.mock-status{font-size:8.5px;font-weight:700;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:100px;font-family:var(--fm);white-space:nowrap}
   152→.mock-status.settled{background:#f8f1f7;color:#691460}
   153→.mock-status.transit{background:#eaf1ff;color:#3457a6}
   154→
   155→/* ---------- FRICTION (light) ---------- */
   156→.friction{background:var(--bg-light)}
   157→.f-cards{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;margin-top:36px}
   158→.f-card{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;padding:24px 22px}
   159→.f-n{font-family:var(--fh);font-size:34px;color:var(--mint);margin-bottom:14px;line-height:1}
   160→.f-t{font-family:var(--fh);font-size:16px;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:8px;letter-spacing:-.2px}
   161→.f-d{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.65}
   162→
   163→/* ---------- BREAKTHROUGH (dark) ---------- */
   164→.breakthrough{background:var(--bg-dark);color:#fff}
   165→.breakthrough h2{color:#fff}
   166→.bt-stats{margin-top:32px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
   167→.bt-stat{background:var(--card-dark);border:1px solid var(--card-border);border-radius:14px;padding:26px;text-align:center}
   168→.bt-n{font-family:var(--fh);font-size:clamp(38px,11vw,48px);color:var(--mint);line-height:1}
   169→.bt-l{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);margin-top:6px}
   170→
   171→/* ---------- TRUST CONTRAST (light) ---------- */
   172→.contrast{background:var(--bg-light)}
   173→.cc-col{border-radius:16px;padding:24px;margin-top:16px}
   174→.cc-col.without{border:1px solid var(--border)}
   175→.cc-col.with{background:var(--bg-dark);color:#fff}
   176→.cc-h{font-family:var(--fh);font-size:17px;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:2px}
   177→.cc-sub{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:18px}
   178→.cc-col.with .cc-sub{color:rgba(255,255,255,.45)}
   179→.cc-item{display:flex;gap:11px;padding:13px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--border)}
   180→.cc-col.with .cc-item{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
   181→.cc-item:first-of-type{border-top:none;padding-top:0}
   182→.cc-icon{width:19px;height:19px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:2px}
   183→.without .cc-icon{background:#f8f1f7;color:var(--red)}
   184→.with .cc-icon{background:rgba(105,20,96,.15);color:var(--mint)}
   185→.cc-item-t{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:2px}
   186→.cc-item-d{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.55}
   187→.cc-col.with .cc-item-d{color:rgba(255,255,255,.5)}
   188→
   189→/* ---------- TESTIMONIALS (light, centered) ---------- */
   190→.voices{background:var(--bg-light);text-align:center}
   191→.voices .eyebrow{justify-content:center}
   192→.voices h2{max-width:520px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
   193→.voices .section-p{margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;text-align:center}
   194→.t-card{margin-top:40px;max-width:420px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
   195→.t-av{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--card-dark);color:var(--mint);font-family:var(--fh);font-size:15px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:0 auto 14px}
   196→.t-name{font-weight:800;font-size:14.5px}
   197→.t-role{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin:4px 0 8px}
   198→.t-stars{color:var(--mint);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:16px}
   199→.t-quote{font-size:16px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.55;color:var(--ink)}
   200→.t-dots{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:6px;margin-top:28px}
   201→.t-dots span{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--border)}
   202→.t-dots span.on{background:var(--mint);width:18px;border-radius:4px}
   203→
   204→/* ---------- MARKET FOCUS + FINAL CTA (dark) ---------- */
   205→.market{background:var(--bg-dark);color:#fff}
   206→.market h2{color:#fff}
   207→.market-sub{font-family:var(--fh);font-size:15px;color:var(--mint);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:16px;line-height:1.3}
   208→.check-list{margin-top:24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
   209→.check-item{display:flex;gap:11px;align-items:flex-start}
   210→.check-icon{width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(105,20,96,.15);color:var(--mint);font-size:10px;font-weight:800;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:2px}
   211→.check-item span{font-size:13.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);line-height:1.55}
   212→.stat-callout{background:var(--card-dark);border:1px solid var(--card-border);border-radius:16px;padding:32px 24px;text-align:center;margin-top:32px}
   213→.stat-callout .bt-n{font-size:clamp(40px,12vw,52px)}
   214→.stat-callout .bt-l{margin-top:8px}
   215→.stat-callout p{font-size:12px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);margin-top:12px;max-width:32ch;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;line-height:1.6}
   216→.final-cta{text-align:center;margin-top:72px}
   217→.final-cta h2{color:#fff}
   218→.final-cta .section-p{margin:0 auto 26px;text-align:center}
   219→.btn-mint{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:var(--mint);color:var(--bg-dark);font-weight:800;font-size:14px;padding:15px 28px;border-radius:100px;border:none;cursor:pointer}
   220→.btn-mint:hover{background:var(--mint-dark)}
   221→
   222→/* ---------- PRICING (dark) ---------- */
   223→.pricing{background:var(--bg-dark);color:#fff}
   224→.pricing h2{color:#fff}
   225→.price-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:16px;margin-top:32px}
   226→.price-card{background:var(--card-dark);border:1px solid var(--card-border);border-radius:16px;padding:26px 22px;position:relative}
   227→.price-card.featured{border-color:var(--mint)}
   228→.price-badge{position:absolute;top:-11px;right:20px;background:var(--mint);color:var(--bg-dark);font-size:9px;font-weight:800;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:100px;font-family:var(--fm);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em}
   229→.price-tier{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:10.5px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5)}
   230→.price-n{font-family:var(--fh);font-size:clamp(24px,6vw,30px);margin:8px 0 2px;color:#fff;line-height:1}
   231→.price-n span{font-size:12px;font-family:var(--fb);font-weight:600;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5)}
   232→.price-who{font-size:11.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);margin-bottom:16px}
   233→.price-list{margin-top:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;list-style:none;padding:0}
   234→.price-list li{font-size:12px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.72);display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start;line-height:1.5}
   235→.price-list li:before{content:'✓';color:var(--mint);font-weight:800;flex-shrink:0}
   236→.price-note{font-size:11.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);text-align:center;margin-top:24px;max-width:52ch;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;line-height:1.6}
   237→
   238→/* ---------- FAQ (light) ---------- */
   239→.faq{background:var(--bg-light)}
   240→.faq .eyebrow{justify-content:center}
   241→.faq h2{text-align:center;max-width:420px;margin:0 auto 36px}
   242→.faq-item{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:12px;overflow:hidden}
   243→.faq-q{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:18px 20px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;list-style:none}
   244→.faq-q::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
   245→.faq-plus{font-family:var(--fh);font-size:18px;color:var(--mint);flex-shrink:0}
   246→details[open] .faq-plus{color:var(--muted)}
   247→.faq-a{padding:0 20px 18px;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.65}
   248→.faq-a a{color:var(--mint-dark);font-weight:700;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:2px;cursor:pointer}
   249→.faq-a strong{color:var(--ink)}
   250→.faq-group{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mint);margin:34px 0 12px}
   251→.faq-group:first-of-type{margin-top:36px}
   252→
   253→/* ---------- FOOTER ---------- */
   254→footer{background:var(--bg-dark);color:#fff;padding:56px 0 28px}
   255→.footer-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5fr repeat(3,1fr);gap:32px}
   256→.footer-brand .pp-logo{font-size:19px}
   257→.footer-desc{font-size:12.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);line-height:1.65;margin-top:14px;max-width:32ch}
   258→.footer-col-h{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.42);margin-bottom:16px}
   259→.footer-col a{display:block;font-size:13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.68);margin-bottom:12px;cursor:pointer}
   260→.footer-col a:hover{color:#fff}
   261→.footer-bottom{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);margin-top:46px;padding-top:20px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 20px;justify-content:space-between}
   262→.foot-copy{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:10.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.35)}
   263→.foot-tagline{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:10.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.35)}
   264→
   265→/* ---------- MERCHANT SIGN-IN CTA (blue, above footer) ---------- */
   266→.merchant-cta{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#3457a6 0%,#2b4a90 100%);position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:64px 24px;text-align:center;color:#fff}
   267→.merchant-cta::before{content:'';position:absolute;width:340px;height:340px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);top:-140px;left:-90px}
   268→.merchant-cta::after{content:'';position:absolute;width:280px;height:280px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);bottom:-120px;right:-70px}
   269→.mc-inner{position:relative;z-index:2;max-width:600px;margin:0 auto}
   270→.mc-lead{font-size:19px;line-height:1.55;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:30px}
   271→.mc-actions{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:13px;max-width:400px;margin:0 auto}
   272→.mc-btn-solid{background:#fff;color:#3457a6;font-weight:800;font-size:15px;padding:16px 28px;border-radius:100px;border:none;cursor:pointer}
   273→.mc-btn-outline{background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:14.5px;padding:15px 28px;border-radius:100px;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.45);cursor:pointer}
   274→.mc-caption{margin-top:22px;font-family:var(--fm);font-size:10.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);letter-spacing:.01em;line-height:1.8}
   275→
   276→
   277→/* ============================================================
   278→   FUNCTIONAL LAYER — search, merchant/building profiles, auth,
   279→   landlord dashboard, agent onboarding. Ported & restyled to
   280→   match the PlugPay marketing design system above.
   281→   ============================================================ */
   282→
   283→/* ---------- EXTENDED TOKENS (functional layer: modals, search, dashboards) ---------- */
   284→:root{
   285→  --accent:#691460; --accent2:#691460; --accent3:#691460; --accent4:#691460;
   286→  --accent-bg:rgba(105,20,96,.12); --accent-bg2:rgba(105,20,96,.30);
   287→  --grad:#691460; --grad2:#691460;
   288→  --purple:#691460; --purple-bg:rgba(105,20,96,.10);
   289→  --blue2:#3457a6; --blue-bg:rgba(52,87,166,.10);
   290→  --green:#691460; --green-bg:#f8f1f7;
   291→  --amber:#BA7517; --amber-bg:#FAEEDA;
   292→  --red-bg:#f8f1f7;
   293→  --bg:#f7f8fc; --bg2:#eef0f7; --white:#fff;
   294→  --border2:#d5d7e3; --ink3:#1c2138; --muted2:#9297ab;
   295→  --r8:16px; --r6:12px; --r4:8px;
   296→  --shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(10,14,28,.07),0 8px 32px rgba(10,14,28,.09);
   297→  --shadow-lg:0 16px 64px rgba(10,14,28,.2);
   298→}
   299→
   300→/* SEARCH RESULTS (shown right below the hero search bar) */
   301→.results-section{background:var(--white);padding:22px;border-radius:16px;margin-top:14px;box-shadow:0 22px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.35);display:none;max-width:506px;text-align:left}
   302→.results-section.on{display:block}
   303→.results-inner{max-width:100%;margin:0 auto}
   304→.results-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}
   305→.results-title{font-size:16px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink)}
   306→.results-meta{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--fm)}
   307→.results-filters{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:20px}
   308→.rf{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:100px;border:1.5px solid var(--border2);background:transparent;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--fm);transition:all .2s}
   309→.rf.on{background:var(--accent-bg);color:var(--accent2);border-color:var(--accent-bg2)}
   310→.results-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:12px;max-height:420px;overflow-y:auto}
   311→.res-card{background:var(--white);border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r8);padding:20px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .25s;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
   312→.res-card:hover{border-color:var(--accent-bg2)}
   313→.rc-top{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;margin-bottom:12px}
   314→.rc-av{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:16px;font-weight:800;color:#fff;flex-shrink:0}
   315→.rc-info{flex:1;min-width:0}
   316→.rc-name{font-size:15px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:2px}
   317→.rc-sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
   318→.rc-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:20px;margin-top:5px;font-family:var(--fm);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em}
   319→.rcb-t{background:rgba(83,74,183,.1);color:var(--purple)}.rcb-v{background:var(--accent-bg);color:var(--accent2)}.rcb-b{background:var(--blue-bg);color:var(--blue2)}
   320→.rc-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:6px;margin-bottom:12px}
   321→.rcs{background:var(--bg);border-radius:var(--r4);padding:8px;text-align:center}
   322→.rcs-n{font-size:15px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:-.5px}
   323→.rcs-l{font-size:9px;color:var(--muted2);font-family:var(--fm);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;margin-top:1px}
   324→.rc-btn{width:100%;padding:9px;border-radius:var(--r6);font-family:var(--fb);font-size:13px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;border:none;background:var(--grad);color:#fff;transition:all .2s}
   325→.rc-btn:hover{background:var(--grad2)}
   326→
   327→/* BUILDING RESULT CARD */
   328→.res-card.bldg .rc-av{border-radius:var(--r4)}
   329→.floor-mini{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:2px;margin-bottom:10px}
   330→.fm-stall{border-radius:3px;height:16px;border:0.5px solid transparent}
   331→.fms-t{background:var(--purple-bg);border-color:#AFA9EC}.fms-v{background:var(--blue-bg);border-color:#85B7EB}.fms-b{background:var(--accent-bg);border-color:#c798c2}.fms-e{background:var(--bg);border-color:var(--border)}
   332→
   333→/* ══════════════════════════════
   334→   MODALS
   335→══════════════════════════════ */
   336→/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
   337→   MODAL SYSTEM — mobile-first sheet from bottom,
   338→   centered panel on ≥ 540px screens
   339→═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
   340→.modal-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.6);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);z-index:1000;display:flex;align-items:stretch;justify-content:stretch;padding:0;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .25s}
   341→.modal-overlay.on{opacity:1;pointer-events:all}
   342→
   343→/* Base modal shell — full screen, covers the whole page */
   344→.modal{background:#fff;border-radius:0;max-width:100vw;width:100vw;max-height:100vh;height:100vh;overflow-y:auto;position:relative;transform:translateY(0) scale(1);transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);box-shadow:none}
   345→.modal-overlay.on .modal{transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}
   346→
   347→/* drag handle hint */
   348→.modal::before{
   349→  content:'';
   350→  display:block;
   351→  width:36px;height:4px;
   352→  background:rgba(0,0,0,.12);
   353→  border-radius:2px;
   354→  margin:10px auto 0;
   355→  flex-shrink:0;
   356→}
   357→
   358→.modal-close{position:absolute;top:14px;right:14px;width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:2px solid #691460;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:18px;font-weight:900;color:#691460;z-index:5;transition:all .2s;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(105,20,96,.35)}
   359→.modal-close:hover,.modal-close:active{background:#fff;border-color:rgba(0,0,0,.34);transform:scale(1.06)}
   360→
   361→/* MERCHANT PROFILE MODAL */
   362→.mp-hero{background:#0a1534;padding:28px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:0}
   363→.mp-hero::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.03) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.03) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:40px 40px;pointer-events:none}
   364→.mp-hero-inner{position:relative;z-index:2}
   365→.mp-top{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:16px;margin-bottom:20px;flex-wrap:wrap}
   366→/* on very small phones let it wrap */
   367→@media(max-width:360px){}
   368→.mp-av{width:72px;height:72px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:26px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;flex-shrink:0;border:3px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
   369→.mp-info{flex:1}
   370→.mp-name{font-size:22px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;letter-spacing:-.5px;margin-bottom:4px}
   371→.mp-biz{font-size:13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);font-family:var(--fm);margin-bottom:8px}
   372→.mp-badges{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
   373→.mp-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:100px;font-family:var(--fm);letter-spacing:.04em}
   374→.mpb-v{background:rgba(105,20,96,.2);color:#691460}
   375→.mpb-b{background:rgba(24,95,165,.2);color:#60a5fa}
   376→.mpb-p{background:rgba(83,74,183,.2);color:#a78bfa}
   377→.mp-rating{text-align:right;flex-shrink:0}
   378→.mp-rating-big{font-size:44px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;letter-spacing:-2px;line-height:1}
   379→.mp-stars-row{color:#fbbf24;font-size:14px;margin-top:2px}
   380→.mp-rev-ct{font-size:11px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.35);font-family:var(--fm);margin-top:2px}
   381→.mp-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px}
   382→@media(min-width:480px){}
   383→.mp-stat{background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);border-radius:var(--r6);padding:12px;text-align:center}
   384→.mp-stat-n{font-size:22px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;letter-spacing:-1px;line-height:1;margin-bottom:2px}
   385→.mp-stat-n.g{color:#691460}.mp-stat-n.b{color:#60a5fa}.mp-stat-n.a{color:#fbbf24}
   386→.mp-stat-l{font-size:9px;color:#444;font-family:var(--fm);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em}
   387→
   388→/* Modal tabs */
   389→.modal-tabs{display:flex;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--bg);sticky:top;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:5}
   390→.modal-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
   391→.modal-tab{flex:1;padding:14px 0;text-align:center;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;transition:all .2s;font-family:var(--fm)}
   392→.modal-tab.on{color:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);background:#fff}
   393→.modal-tab-body{display:none;padding:24px}.modal-tab-body.on{display:block}
   394→
   395→/* Catalogue */
   396→.cat-filters{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:20px}
   397→.cat-filter{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;padding:6px 13px;border-radius:100px;border:1.5px solid var(--border);background:transparent;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--fm);transition:all .2s}
   398→.cat-filter.on{background:var(--accent-bg);color:var(--accent2);border-color:var(--accent-bg2)}
   399→.cat-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:12px}
   400→@media(min-width:769px){.cat-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:14px}}
   401→.cat-item{border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r6);overflow:hidden;transition:all .2s;cursor:pointer}
   402→.cat-item:hover{border-color:var(--accent-bg2);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
   403→.cat-img{height:100px;background:var(--bg);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:36px}
   404→.cat-body{padding:10px 12px}
   405→.cat-name{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:2px}
   406→.cat-price{font-size:14px;font-weight:800;color:var(--accent);font-family:var(--fb)}
   407→.cat-stock{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted2);font-family:var(--fm);margin-top:2px}
   408→.cat-buy{width:100%;padding:8px;border-radius:var(--r4);font-family:var(--fb);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;border:none;background:var(--accent3);color:#fff;margin-top:8px;transition:all .2s}
   409→.cat-buy:hover{background:var(--accent)}
   410→
   411→/* Reviews */
   412→.rev-summary{display:flex;gap:20px;align-items:center;background:var(--bg);border-radius:var(--r6);padding:16px;margin-bottom:20px}
   413→.rev-big-num{font-size:56px;font-weight:900;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:-2px;line-height:1}
   414→.rev-stars-big{color:#fbbf24;font-size:18px;margin-top:4px}
   415→.rev-sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--fm);margin-top:4px}
   416→.rev-bars{flex:1}
   417→.rev-bar-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:4px}
   418→.rev-bar-lbl{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--fm);width:20px;text-align:right;flex-shrink:0}
   419→.rev-bar-track{flex:1;height:6px;background:var(--bg2);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden}
   420→.rev-bar-fill{height:6px;border-radius:3px;background:#fbbf24}
   421→.rev-bar-ct{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted2);width:24px;text-align:right;flex-shrink:0}
   422→.rev-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
   423→.rev-item{background:var(--bg);border-radius:var(--r6);padding:14px}
   424→.rev-item-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:8px}
   425→.rev-item-av{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;flex-shrink:0}
   426→.rev-item-name{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink)}
   427→.rev-item-date{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted2);margin-top:1px;font-family:var(--fm)}
   428→.rev-item-stars{color:#fbbf24;font-size:12px;margin-left:auto}
   429→.rev-item-text{font-size:13px;color:var(--ink3);line-height:1.6}
   430→.rev-verified{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-size:10px;color:var(--green);font-family:var(--fm);margin-top:6px}
   431→
   432→/* Building modal */
   433→.bldg-hero{background:#691460;padding:24px 28px;border-radius:0;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
   434→.bldg-hero::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.04) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.04) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:40px 40px;pointer-events:none}
   435→.bh-inner{position:relative;z-index:2}
   436→.bh-name{font-size:26px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;letter-spacing:-.5px;margin-bottom:4px}
   437→.bh-addr{font-size:13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);font-family:var(--fm);margin-bottom:16px}
   438→.bh-stats{display:flex;gap:0}
   439→.bh-stat{padding:0 24px;border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);text-align:center}
   440→.bh-stat:first-child{padding-left:0}
   441→.bh-stat:last-child{border-right:none}
   442→.bh-n{font-size:28px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;letter-spacing:-1px;line-height:1;margin-bottom:2px}
   443→.bh-l{font-size:10px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);font-family:var(--fm);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em}
   444→.bldg-body{padding:24px}
   445→.bldg-map-section{margin-bottom:20px}
   446→.bldg-map-label{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--fm);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;margin-bottom:10px}
   447→.bldg-floor-tabs{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
   448→.bft{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;padding:5px 13px;border-radius:100px;border:1.5px solid var(--border);background:transparent;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--fm);transition:all .2s}
   449→.bft.on{background:var(--accent-bg);color:var(--accent2);border-color:var(--accent-bg2)}
   450→.bldg-stall-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:5px;margin-bottom:12px}
   451→.bsg{border-radius:6px;padding:7px 5px;text-align:center;border:1px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .1s}
   452→.bsg:hover{transform:scale(1.08)}
   453→.bsg-t{background:var(--purple-bg);border-color:#AFA9EC}
   454→.bsg-v{background:var(--blue-bg);border-color:#85B7EB}
   455→.bsg-b{background:var(--accent-bg);border-color:#c798c2}
   456→.bsg-e{background:var(--bg);border-color:var(--border)}
   457→.bsg-id{font-size:8px;color:var(--muted2);font-family:var(--fm)}
   458→.bsg-nm{font-size:9px;font-weight:700;margin-top:2px;line-height:1.2}
   459→.bsgn-t{color:var(--purple)}.bsgn-v{color:var(--blue2)}.bsgn-b{color:var(--accent2)}.bsgn-e{color:var(--border2)}
   460→.bldg-legend{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
   461→.bl-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:2px;display:inline-block;margin-right:4px;flex-shrink:0;vertical-align:middle}
   462→
   463→/* Merchant list in building */
   464→.bldg-merch-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
   465→.bml-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:var(--bg);border-radius:var(--r6);padding:12px 14px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;border:1.5px solid transparent}
   466→.bml-item:hover{border-color:var(--accent-bg2);background:var(--accent-bg)}
   467→.bml-av{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:14px;font-weight:800;color:#fff;flex-shrink:0}
   468→.bml-info{flex:1}
   469→.bml-name{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink)}
   470→.bml-sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:1px}
   471→.bml-right{text-align:right}
   472→.bml-stars{color:#fbbf24;font-size:12px}
   473→.bml-rev{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted2);margin-top:1px;font-family:var(--fm)}
   474→
   475→/* Quick actions modal */
   476→.qa-modal{padding:28px}
   477→.qa-modal-title{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:6px}
   478→.qa-modal-sub{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:24px;font-family:var(--fm)}
   479→.qa-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
   480→.qa-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;background:var(--bg);border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r6);padding:16px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s}
   481→.qa-item:active{border-color:var(--accent-bg2);background:var(--accent-bg);}
   482→.qa-ico{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:var(--r4);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:20px;flex-shrink:0}
   483→.qi1{background:var(--accent-bg)}.qi2{background:var(--blue-bg)}.qi3{background:var(--green-bg)}.qi4{background:var(--purple-bg)}.qi5{background:var(--amber-bg)}
   484→.qa-label{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink)}
   485→.qa-desc{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px}
   486→.qa-arr{margin-left:auto;color:var(--muted2);font-size:20px}
   487→
   488→/* Receipt modal */
   489→.receipt-modal{background:#0f0e14;border-radius:0;max-width:100vw;width:100vw;height:100vh;max-height:100vh;overflow-y:auto}
   490→.modal-overlay.on .receipt-modal{transform:translateY(0)}
   491→.rm-top{background:var(--grad);padding:24px;border-radius:0;text-align:center}
   492→.rm-icon{width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:24px;margin:0 auto 12px}
   493→.rm-title{font-size:18px;font-weight:800;color:#fff;margin-bottom:4px}
   494→.rm-sub{font-size:12px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);font-family:var(--fm)}
   495→.rm-body{padding:20px}
   496→.rm-rows{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;margin-bottom:16px}
   497→.rm-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:13px;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:var(--r4)}
   498→.rm-row:nth-child(odd){background:rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
   499→.rm-lbl{color:#555}.rm-val{color:#ccc;font-weight:500}
   500→.rm-row.total{background:rgba(105,20,96,.1);border:1px solid rgba(105,20,96,.2)}
   501→.rm-row.total .rm-lbl{color:var(--accent4);font-weight:700}
   502→.rm-row.total .rm-val{color:var(--accent4);font-weight:800;font-size:15px}
   503→.rm-verified{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:rgba(105,20,96,.08);border:1px solid rgba(105,20,96,.2);border-radius:var(--r4);padding:10px 12px;margin-bottom:16px}
   504→.rm-verified-text{font-size:12px;color:#691460;font-family:var(--fm)}
   505→.rm-actions{display:flex;gap:8px}
   506→.rm-btn{flex:1;padding:12px;border-radius:var(--r6);font-family:var(--fb);font-size:14px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;border:none;transition:all .2s}
   507→.rmb-primary{background:var(--grad);color:#fff}
   508→.rmb-secondary{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);color:#aaa}
   509→
   510→/* TOAST */
   511→.toast{position:fixed;bottom:32px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(20px);background:var(--ink);color:#fff;padding:12px 24px;border-radius:100px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;z-index:2000;opacity:0;transition:all .3s;pointer-events:none;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
   512→.toast.on{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}
   513→
   514→/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   515→   TRADER PROFILE MODAL — exact screenshot match
   516→═══════════════════════════════════════════ */
   517→.tpModal{background:#f7f8fc;
   518→  border-radius:0;
   519→  max-width:100vw;
   520→  width:100vw;
   521→  height:100vh;
   522→  max-height:100vh;
   523→  overflow:hidden;
   524→  display:flex;
   525→  flex-direction:column;
   526→  position:relative;}
   527→
   528→/* header — PlugPay blue→magenta gradient */
   529→.tp-header{background:#691460;
   530→  padding:31px 14px 14px;
   531→  position:relative;
   532→  flex-shrink:0;}
   533→.tp-close{position:absolute;
   534→  top:10px;right:10px;
   535→  width:34px;height:34px;
   536→  border-radius:50%;
   537→  background:#fff;
   538→  border:2px solid #691460;cursor:pointer;
   539→  color:#691460;
   540→  font-size:16px;font-weight:900;
   541→  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
   542→  box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(105,20,96,.45);
   543→  z-index:5;}
   544→.tp-close:hover,.tp-close:active{background:rgba(0,0,0,.46);border-color:#fff;transform:scale(1.06)}
   545→.tp-eyebrow{font-family:var(--fm);
   546→  font-size:8px;
   547→  letter-spacing:.18em;
   548→  text-transform:uppercase;
   549→  color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);
   550→  margin-bottom:4px;}
   551→.tp-biz-name{font-size:16px;
   552→  font-weight:800;
   553→  color:#fff;
   554→  letter-spacing:-.4px;
   555→  line-height:1.15;}
   556→
   557→/* scrollable body */
   558→.tp-body{flex:1;
   559→  overflow-y:auto;
   560→  -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;
   561→  background:#f7f8fc;
   562→  padding-bottom:64px;}
   563→
   564→/* cards — white with border-radius matching screenshot */
   565→.tp-card{background:#fff;
   566→  border-radius:13px;
   567→  margin:9px 9px 0;
   568→  overflow:hidden;
   569→  border:1px solid #e7e8ef;}
   570→
   571→/* identity card */
   572→.tp-id-card{padding:10px}
   573→.tp-id-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
   574→.tp-avatar-wrap{position:relative;flex-shrink:0}
   575→.tp-avatar{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;
   576→  background:#691460;
   577→  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
   578→  font-size:19px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;
   579→  border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);}
   580→.tp-av-check{position:absolute;bottom:2px;right:2px;
   581→  width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;
   582→  background:#691460;
   583→  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
   584→  font-size:7px;color:#fff;
   585→  border:2px solid #fff;}
   586→.tp-id-name{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:#0a0e1c;margin-bottom:2px}
   587→.tp-id-verified{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;
   588→  background:#e8eeff;color:#691460;
   589→  font-size:8px;font-weight:700;
   590→  padding:2px 7px;border-radius:20px;
   591→  margin-bottom:3px;}
   592→.tp-v-icon{font-size:9px}
   593→.tp-id-owner{font-size:11px;color:#0a0e1c;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:3px;letter-spacing:-.1px}
   594→.tp-id-stars{font-size:10px;color:#6b6490}
   595→.tp-id-stars strong{color:#0a0e1c;font-size:11px}
   596→.tp-rev-count{font-size:9px;color:#9b97b8}
   597→
   598→/* stats card — 4 equal columns no padding */
   599→.tp-stats-card{display:flex;border-radius:13px;overflow:hidden;padding:0}
   600→.tp-stat-cell{flex:1;padding:13px 6px;text-align:center}
   601→.tp-stat-n{font-size:20px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.5px;line-height:1;margin-bottom:3px}
   602→.tp-stat-n.blue{color:#691460}
   603→.tp-stat-n.purple{color:#691460}
   604→.tp-stat-n.green{color:#691460}
   605→.tp-stat-n.amber{color:#BA7517}
   606→.tp-stat-l{font-size:8px;font-weight:700;color:#9b97b8;font-family:var(--fm);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em}
   607→
   608→/* ── Profile hero (name / about / location / social — redesigned) ── */
   609→.tp-navbar-fixed{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:14px 14px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#691460 0%,#691460 100%);position:relative;z-index:6;flex-shrink:0}
   610→.tp-navbar-btn{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);border:none;color:#fff;font-size:15px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0;transition:background .15s}
   611→.tp-navbar-btn:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.3)}
   612→.tp-navbar-title{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.85)}
   613→.tp-hero{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#691460 0%,#691460 100%);padding:6px 20px 46px;text-align:center;border-radius:0 0 34px 34px;position:relative}
   614→.tp-hero-avatar-wrap{position:relative;width:88px;height:88px;margin:14px auto 12px}
   615→.tp-hero-avatar{width:88px;height:88px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;color:#691460;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:32px;font-weight:900;border:3px solid rgba(255,255,255,.65);box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
   616→.tp-hero-av-check{position:absolute;bottom:2px;right:2px;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;color:#691460;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;border:2.5px solid #691460}
   617→.tp-hero-name{font-size:19px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;letter-spacing:-.3px;margin-bottom:3px}
   618→.tp-hero-role{font-size:11.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px}
   619→.tp-hero-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#fff;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:700;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:100px;margin-bottom:12px;font-family:var(--fm)}
   620→.tp-hero-bio{font-size:11.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.88);line-height:1.6;max-width:280px;margin:0 auto 6px}
   621→.tp-hero-loc{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px;font-size:10.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.72);font-family:var(--fm);margin:0 auto 16px}
   622→.tp-hero-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:20px}
   623→.tp-hero-btn{padding:9px 22px;border-radius:100px;font-family:var(--fb);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s}
   624→.tp-hero-btn-solid{background:#fff;color:#691460;border:none;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
   625→.tp-hero-btn-solid.following{background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);color:#fff;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.6)}
   626→.tp-hero-btn-outline{background:transparent;color:#fff;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.55)}
   627→.tp-hero-stats{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:0;background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:14px;padding:12px 8px;max-width:320px;margin:0 auto}
   628→.tp-hero-stat{flex:1;text-align:center;border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22)}
   629→.tp-hero-stat:last-child{border-right:none}
   630→.tp-hero-stat-n{font-size:16px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;letter-spacing:-.3px;line-height:1}
   631→.tp-hero-stat-l{font-size:8px;font-family:var(--fm);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);margin-top:3px}
   632→
   633→/* My works / catalogue preview strip on Profile tab */
   634→.tp-works-strip{display:flex;gap:9px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:2px;scrollbar-width:none}
   635→.tp-works-strip::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
   636→.tp-works-card{flex:0 0 104px;cursor:pointer}
   637→.tp-works-img{width:104px;height:78px;border-radius:11px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:26px;margin-bottom:6px}
   638→.tp-works-label{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;color:#0a0e1c;line-height:1.3}

   640→
   641→/* Social media list */
   642→.tp-social-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
   643→.tp-social-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:9px 10px;border-radius:10px;background:#f7f8fc;border:1px solid #e7e8ef;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s}
   644→.tp-social-row:hover{background:#eef0f7}
   645→.tp-social-ico{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:7px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:11px;flex-shrink:0}
   646→.tp-social-handle{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;color:#0a0e1c;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
   647→
   648→/* info rows card */
   649→.tp-info-card{padding:0}
   650→.tp-info-row{
   651→  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;
   652→  padding:11px 13px;
   653→  border-bottom:1px solid #f7f8fc;
   654→}
   655→.tp-info-ico{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:8px;
   656→  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
   657→  font-size:14px;flex-shrink:0;}
   658→.tp-info-label{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#9b97b8;margin-bottom:2px}
   659→.tp-info-val{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#0a0e1c}
   660→
   661→/* connect card */
   662→.tp-connect-card{
   663→  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;
   664→  padding:11px 13px;
   665→}
   666→.tp-connect-label{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#9b97b8;flex-shrink:0;min-width:48px}
   667→.tp-connect-icons{display:flex;gap:8px}
   668→.tp-social-btn{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;
   669→  border:none;cursor:pointer;
   670→  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
   671→  font-size:13px;font-weight:800;color:#fff;
   672→  transition:transform .15s,opacity .15s;

   674→.tp-social-btn:active{transform:scale(.92);opacity:.8}
   675→.tp-insta{background:linear-gradient(45deg,#f09433,#e6683c,#dc2743,#cc2366,#bc1888)}
   676→
   677→/* ── payment info card ── */
   678→.tp-pay-info-card{padding:13px}
   679→.tp-pay-info-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:11px}
   680→.tp-pay-info-title{font-size:13px;font-weight:800;color:#0a0e1c;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
   681→.tp-pay-info-icon{font-size:15px}
   682→.tp-pay-info-badge{background:#f8f1f7;color:#691460;
   683→  font-size:9px;font-weight:700;
   684→  padding:2px 8px;border-radius:100px;
   685→  font-family:var(--fm);letter-spacing:.05em;
   686→  border:1px solid #c798c2;}
   687→.tp-pay-info-rows{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0;background:#f4f3ef;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:11px}
   688→.tp-pay-info-row{
   689→  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
   690→  padding:10px 11px;
   691→  border-bottom:1px solid #e7e8ef;
   692→}
   693→.tp-pay-info-ico{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:8px;

   696→.tp-pay-info-text{flex:1;min-width:0}
   697→.tp-pay-info-label{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:8px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#9b97b8;margin-bottom:2px}
   698→.tp-pay-info-val{font-size:16px;font-weight:900;color:#0a0e1c;letter-spacing:.5px;font-family:var(--fm)}
   699→.tp-copy-btn{background:#fff;border:1.5px solid #d4d0f0;
   700→  border-radius:6px;padding:5px 10px;
   701→  font-family:var(--fb);font-size:10px;font-weight:700;
   702→  color:#534AB7;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0;
   703→  transition:all .15s;}
   704→.tp-copy-btn:active{background:#EEEDFE;border-color:#534AB7}
   705→.tp-pay-now-btn{width:100%;padding:11px;
   706→  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#691460,#51104a);
   707→  color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:10px;

   709→  cursor:pointer;
   710→  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;
   711→  transition:all .2s;margin-bottom:8px;}
   712→.tp-pay-now-btn:active{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#51104a,#380b33)}
   713→.tp-pay-arrow{font-size:15px}
   714→.tp-pay-note{font-size:10px;color:#9b97b8;line-height:1.55;
   715→  text-align:center;
   716→  padding:0 4px;}
   717→.tp-pay-note strong{color:#534AB7}
   718→
   719→/* tabs inside the body */
   720→.tp-tabs{
   721→  margin:9px 0 0;
   722→  overflow:hidden;
   723→  overflow-x:auto;
   724→  border-top:1px solid #e7e8ef;

   730→.tp-tabs .modal-tab{font-size:10px;padding:9px 0;font-family:var(--fm)}

   732→
   733→/* section title in tab bodies */
   734→.tp-section-title{font-size:13px;font-weight:800;color:#0a0e1c;margin-bottom:8px}
   735→.tp-section-body{font-size:12px;color:#6b6490;line-height:1.6}
   736→
   737→/* verification docs */
   738→.tp-docs-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px;margin-bottom:6px}
   739→.tp-doc-item{
   740→  background:#f4f3ef;border-radius:8px;
   741→  padding:14px 10px;
   742→  display:flex;flex-direction:column;
   743→  align-items:center;justify-content:center;
   744→  gap:8px;text-align:center;min-height:64px;
   745→  border:1px solid #e7e8ef;
   746→}
   747→.tp-doc-wide{
   748→  background:#f4f3ef;border-radius:8px;
   749→  padding:14px 10px;
   750→  display:flex;flex-direction:column;
   751→  align-items:center;justify-content:center;
   752→  gap:8px;text-align:center;min-height:64px;
   753→  border:1px solid #e7e8ef;
   754→  width:100%;
   755→}
   756→.tp-doc-label{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#9b97b8}
   757→.tp-doc-badge{background:#f8f1f7;color:#691460;
   758→  font-size:11px;font-weight:700;
   759→  padding:4px 13px;border-radius:100px;
   760→  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;}
   761→
   762→/* shop photo slider */
   763→.tp-photo-slider{position:relative;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;background:#e7e8ef;min-height:128px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
   764→.tp-photo-frame{width:100%;min-height:128px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:38px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#c8c4f4,#a8a4e4)}
   765→.tp-photo-placeholder{font-size:38px;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.15))}
   766→.tp-slide-btn{position:absolute;
   767→  width:29px;height:29px;border-radius:50%;
   768→  background:rgba(255,255,255,.85);
   769→  border:none;cursor:pointer;
   770→  font-size:15px;font-weight:700;
   771→  color:#0a0e1c;
   772→  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
   773→  box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.15);
   774→  top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);

   776→.tp-slide-prev{left:8px}
   777→.tp-slide-next{right:8px}
   778→
   779→/* ── sticky Pay Trader bar ── */
   780→.tp-footer{
   781→  position:sticky;bottom:0;
   782→  background:#fff;

   785→  display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;
   786→  z-index:10;
   787→  flex-shrink:0;

   789→.tp-pay-btn{flex:1;
   790→  background:#691460;

   798→  transition:opacity .2s;}
   799→.tp-pay-btn:active{opacity:.86}
   800→.tp-pay-icon{font-size:15px}
   801→.tp-foot-btn{width:42px;height:42px;

   827→.tp-follow-btn{margin-top:10px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:7px 16px;border-radius:100px;background:var(--grad);color:#fff;border:none;font-family:var(--fb);font-weight:800;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(105,20,96,.25)}

   848→.cat-share-bar strong{flex:1;min-width:120px;color:var(--accent);font-weight:800}

   851→/* ── from plugpay-next: building tab redesign (stats card, no vouch list here) ── */
   852→.bldg-card-redesign{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#f8f7ff 0%,#eef0ff 100%);border:1px solid #e0deff;border-radius:14px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:14px;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(105,20,96,.06)}

   880→/* ── from plugpay-next: plc-* (PayLink + Record-sale modals share this system) ── */

   908→  font-family:var(--fb);margin-top:2px;margin-bottom:4px;
   909→}
   910→.plc-add-item:active{opacity:.8}
   911→.plc-total-row{

   915→  font-weight:800;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink);

   923→.tp-pay-info-card{padding:13px}

   947→.tp-pay-info-val{font-size:16px;font-weight:900;color:#0a0e1c;letter-spacing:.5px;font-family:var(--fm)}
   948→.tp-copy-btn{

   976→/* ── Centre-align all CTAs outside the hero ── */

   997→.load-more-btn:hover{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border-color:var(--accent)}

  1000→/* ════════════════════════════════
  1001→   MOBILE ≤ 768px
  1002→════════════════════════════════ */
  1003→@media(max-width:768px){
  1004→  html,body{overflow-x:hidden;width:100%;max-width:100vw}
  1005→
  1006→  .footer-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:28px 20px}
  1007→  .footer-brand{grid-column:1/-1}
  1008→  .mc-lead{font-size:17px}
  1009→
  1010→  /* NAV */
  1011→  .nav-mid,.nav-link{display:none}
  1012→  .nav-wrap{padding:0 14px;width:100%}
  1013→  .nav-signin{padding:6px 12px;font-size:11px}
  1014→  .nav-cta{padding:7px 14px;font-size:11px}
  1015→
  1016→  /* HERO */
  1017→  .hero{padding:28px 14px 40px;text-align:center;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box}
  1018→  .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:24px;width:100%}
  1019→  .mobile-br{display:block}
  1020→  .hero-h1{font-size:clamp(15px,4.44vw,18px)}
  1021→  .hero-sub{font-size:clamp(9.6px,2.76vw,11.4px);margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;max-width:100%}
  1022→  .hero-badge{font-size:9px;padding:4px 10px}
  1023→  .hero-trust{justify-content:center;font-size:9px;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;width:100%}
  1024→  .hero-stats{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;margin-top:16px;padding-top:12px}
  1025→  .hstat{padding:10px 8px}
  1026→  .hstat-n{font-size:20px}
  1027→  .hstat-l{font-size:7px}
  1028→  .hero-search-wrap{width:100%;box-sizing:border-box}
  1029→  .hero-search-box{width:100%;box-sizing:border-box}
  1030→  .hsb-tabs{width:100%}
  1031→  .hsb-tab{font-size:9px;padding:8px 4px}
  1032→  .hsb-input-row{width:100%;min-width:0;box-sizing:border-box}
  1033→  .hsb-input-row input{min-width:0;width:100%;font-size:13px}
  1034→  .hsb-btn{padding:8px 12px;font-size:11px;flex-shrink:0}
  1035→  .hero-right{order:2;width:100%}
  1036→  .hero-right>div{padding:0 8px !important;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box}
  1037→  .phone-2d{width:168px;margin:0 auto}
  1038→  .phone-screen{height:336px}
  1039→  .chip{display:none}
  1040→
  1041→  /* RESULTS */
  1042→  .results-section{padding:24px 14px;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box}
  1043→  .results-inner{width:100%}
  1044→  .results-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr !important;width:100%}
  1045→  .results-header{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  1046→  .results-filters{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
  1047→  .res-card{width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;padding:14px}
  1048→  .rc-av{width:40px;height:40px;font-size:13px}
  1049→  .rc-name{font-size:13px}
  1050→  .rcs-n{font-size:13px}
  1051→
  1052→  /* SHOWCASE */
  1053→  .showcase-section{padding:36px 0 0;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box}
  1054→  .merchant-card-wrap{padding:16px 14px;border-radius:16px 16px 0 0;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box}
  1055→  .mc-header{flex-direction:column;gap:10px;padding-bottom:12px;margin-bottom:12px}
  1056→  .mc-header-right{text-align:left;margin-left:0}
  1057→  .mc-rating-big{font-size:30px}
  1058→  .mc-avatar{width:52px;height:52px;font-size:18px}
  1059→  .mc-name{font-size:16px}
  1060→  .mc-biz{font-size:11px}
  1061→  .mc-stats{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px}
  1062→  .mc-stat{padding:10px 6px}
  1063→  .mc-stat-n{font-size:18px}
  1064→  .mc-stat-l{font-size:8px}
  1065→  .mc-reviews-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:8px}
  1066→  .mc-rev{padding:10px 12px}
  1067→  .mc-action-strip{flex-direction:column;gap:8px;padding:12px}
  1068→  .mc-btn-primary,.mc-btn-secondary{width:100%;justify-content:center;font-size:13px}
  1069→  .mc-pay-note{font-size:11px}
  1070→
  1071→  /* HOW IT WORKS */
  1072→  .how-section{padding:40px 14px;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box}
  1073→  .how-inner{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:24px;width:100%}
  1074→  .how-visual{display:none}
  1075→  .section-h{font-size:clamp(32px,9vw,44px);letter-spacing:-1px;line-height:1.06}
  1076→  .section-p{font-size:13px;margin-bottom:20px}
  1077→  .step{padding:22px 18px}
  1078→  .step-n{font-size:28px;margin-bottom:10px}
  1079→  .step-t{font-size:14px;margin-bottom:4px}
  1080→  .step-d{font-size:12px}
  1081→
  1082→  /* FEATURES */

  1104→

  1123→
  1124→  /* FOOTER */

  1134→  /* Reviews tab — keep bar rows readable */

  1186→/* ── Sign-in profile completion styles ── */
  1187→.prof-tab{
  1188→  flex:1;padding:7px 6px;text-align:center;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;
  1189→  font-family:var(--fm);letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;
  1190→  color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);cursor:pointer;border-radius:8px;
  1191→  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);
  1192→  transition:all .2s;white-space:nowrap;
  1193→}
  1194→.prof-tab.on{background:rgba(255,255,255,.95);color:var(--accent);border-color:transparent}
  1195→.prof-panel{display:none;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}

  1197→.prof-lbl{
  1198→  font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--fm);
  1199→  display:block;margin-bottom:5px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;
  1200→}
  1201→.prof-input{
  1202→  width:100%;padding:11px 13px;
  1203→  border:1.5px solid var(--border2);border-radius:var(--r6);
  1204→  font-size:13.5px;font-family:var(--fb);outline:none;
  1205→  background:#fff;transition:border-color .2s;color:var(--ink);
  1206→}
  1207→.prof-input:focus{border-color:var(--accent)}

  1209→select.prof-input{cursor:pointer}
  1210→.prof-save-btn{
  1211→  width:100%;padding:13px;border-radius:100px;
  1212→  background:var(--grad);color:#fff;font-family:var(--fb);
  1213→  font-size:14px;font-weight:800;border:none;cursor:pointer;
  1214→  margin-top:4px;transition:all .2s;
  1215→}
  1216→.prof-save-btn:active{background:var(--grad2)}
  1217→
  1218→/* doc upload items */

  1246→.ob-modal{background:#fff;border-radius:0;max-width:100vw;width:100vw;max-height:100vh;height:100vh;overflow-y:auto;position:relative;transform:translateY(0) scale(1);transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);box-shadow:none}
  1247→.modal-overlay.on .ob-modal{transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}
  1248→
  1249→/* #ob-main-content wraps .ob-header/.ob-body/.ob-footer and is toggled
  1250→   display:none → display:flex in JS (see obAgentVerifyOtp/openOnboard).
  1251→   It has to be a flex column itself — matching .ob-modal — or its
  1252→   children's flex:1 / flex-shrink:0 rules do nothing, .ob-body grows to
  1253→   fit all its content instead of scrolling internally, and .ob-footer
  1254→   (with the Continue/Publish button) gets pushed past the modal's
  1255→   clipped, non-scrolling bottom edge. */
  1256→#ob-main-content{flex-direction:column;flex:1;min-height:0;overflow:hidden}
  1257→
  1258→.ob-header{background:var(--grad);padding:22px 20px 18px;border-radius:0;position:relative}
  1259→.ob-title{font-size:18px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;margin-bottom:3px}
  1260→.ob-sub{font-size:12px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7)}

  1262→.ob-step-pip{height:3px;border-radius:100px;flex:1;background:rgba(255,255,255,.25);transition:background .3s}
  1263→.ob-step-pip.done{background:#fff}
  1264→.ob-step-pip.active{background:rgba(255,255,255,.75)}
  1265→.ob-body{padding:20px}
  1266→.ob-step{display:none}
  1267→.ob-step.active{display:block}
  1268→.ob-step-label{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:14px}
  1269→.ob-section-title{font-size:16px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:6px}

  1271→.ob-field{margin-bottom:14px}
  1272→.ob-label{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--fm);display:block;margin-bottom:5px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em}
  1273→.ob-input{width:100%;padding:11px 13px;border:1.5px solid var(--border2);border-radius:var(--r6);font-size:13px;font-family:var(--fb);outline:none;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);transition:border-color .2s}
  1274→.ob-input:focus{border-color:var(--accent)}
  1275→.ob-select{width:100%;padding:11px 13px;border:1.5px solid var(--border2);border-radius:var(--r6);font-size:13px;font-family:var(--fb);outline:none;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);appearance:none;cursor:pointer}
  1276→.ob-row-2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
  1277→/* Per-floor stall entry rows */
  1278→.ob-floor-row{
  1279→  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  1280→  align-items:center;gap:0;
  1281→  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
  1282→  background:#fff;
  1283→}
  1284→.ob-floor-row:last-child{border-bottom:none}
  1285→.ob-floor-row-label{
  1286→  padding:11px 14px;
  1287→  font-family:var(--fm);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);
  1288→  border-right:1px solid var(--border);
  1289→  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;
  1290→}
  1291→.ob-floor-row-label .fl-ico{font-size:14px}

  1293→  padding:0 10px;
  1294→}
  1295→.ob-floor-row-input input{
  1296→  width:100%;border:none;outline:none;
  1297→  font-size:15px;font-weight:700;font-family:var(--fm);
  1298→  color:var(--accent);padding:12px 0;
  1299→  background:transparent;
  1300→  -moz-appearance:textfield;
  1301→}
  1302→.ob-floor-row-input input::-webkit-outer-spin-button,
  1303→.ob-floor-row-input input::-webkit-inner-spin-button{-webkit-appearance:none}

  1305→
  1306→.ob-stall-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:6px;margin-bottom:4px}
  1307→.ob-stall-cell{aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:6px;border:1.5px solid var(--border);background:var(--bg);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;font-family:var(--fm)}
  1308→.ob-stall-cell:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent-bg)}
  1309→.ob-stall-cell.selected{border-color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent);color:#fff}
  1310→.ob-stall-cell.occupied{background:#f3e8f2;border-color:#c798c2;color:#691460;cursor:not-allowed}
  1311→.ob-stall-legend{display:flex;gap:14px;margin-bottom:16px}

  1314→.ob-merchant-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;max-height:240px;overflow-y:auto;margin-bottom:14px}
  1315→.ob-merchant-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:var(--bg);border-radius:var(--r6);padding:10px 12px;border:1.5px solid var(--border)}
  1316→.ob-merchant-av{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--grad);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;flex-shrink:0}
  1317→.ob-merchant-name{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink)}

  1320→.ob-ms-done{background:var(--green-bg);color:var(--green)}

  1322→.ob-add-merchant-btn{width:100%;padding:11px;border:1.5px dashed var(--border2);border-radius:var(--r6);background:transparent;font-family:var(--fb);font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent);cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;transition:all .15s}
  1323→.ob-add-merchant-btn:active{background:var(--accent-bg)}
  1324→.ob-summary-card{background:var(--bg);border-radius:var(--r6);padding:16px;border:1.5px solid var(--border);margin-bottom:12px}
  1325→.ob-summary-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:7px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}

  1328→.ob-summary-val{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink)}
  1329→.ob-progress-ring{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:16px;background:var(--accent);border-radius:var(--r6);padding:16px;margin-bottom:14px;color:#fff}
  1330→.ob-ring-num{font-size:32px;font-weight:900;line-height:1}

  1332→.ob-footer{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:14px 20px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);background:#fff;border-radius:0;position:sticky;bottom:0}
  1333→.ob-btn-primary{flex:1;padding:12px;background:var(--grad);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:100px;font-family:var(--fb);font-size:14px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s}
  1334→.ob-btn-primary:active{background:var(--grad2)}
  1335→.ob-btn-back{padding:12px 16px;background:var(--bg);border:1.5px solid var(--border2);border-radius:100px;font-family:var(--fb);font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s}
  1336→.ob-btn-back:active{background:var(--border)}

  1338→/* ── from plugpay-next: section dividers, document upload rows, payment group ── */
  1339→.ob-section-divider{margin:14px 0 10px;padding:8px 12px;background:var(--accent-bg);border-left:3px solid var(--accent);border-radius:6px;font-family:var(--fm);font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent2)}

  1383→   PROFILE MODAL — full-viewport "page", not a sheet

  1385→   so it wins over the mobile/desktop .tpModal rules
  1386→   above regardless of viewport width.
  1387→
  1388→   Uses position:fixed + inset:0 rather than width:100vw/
  1389→   height:100vh — vw/vh-based sizing is well known to leave
  1390→   a stray gap in some in-app browsers / WebViews (e.g. the
  1391→   one WhatsApp opens links in), since 100vw can include a
  1392→   scrollbar gutter the visual viewport doesn't have. inset:0
  1393→   sizes to the actual viewport rectangle every time.
  1394→═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  1395→#modal-merchant{padding:0;align-items:stretch;justify-content:stretch}

  1565→<!-- ============ THE FRICTION ============ -->

  1570→    <p class="section-p">Social selling has turned every trader's DMs into a storefront. Millions of Kenyans buy and sell this way daily — but transacting with a stranger over chat is still a gamble for everyone involved.</p>

  1574→        <div class="f-t">Register your stall in 3 minutes</div>

  1584→        <div class="f-t">Receipt arrives on buyer's WhatsApp</div>

  1586→      </div>
  1587→      <div class="f-card">
  1588→        <div class="f-n">04</div>

  1591→      </div>
  1592→    </div>

  1604→    <p class="section-p">PlugPay verifies every seller's ID and location, anchors every sale to a real WhatsApp receipt, and builds a public trust profile automatically — so buyers can check you out before they pay, and you can grow past people who already know you.</p>

  1640→<!-- ============ PRICING ============ -->
  1641→<section class="pricing" id="pricing">
  1642→  <div class="wrap">
  1643→    <div class="eyebrow on-dark">Pricing</div>
  1644→    <h2>Free for every trader. No catch.</h2>
  1645→    <p class="section-p" style="color:rgba(255,255,255,.6)">PlugPay never takes a hidden cut of your sales, and never charges you to be verified, listed, or found. The trust layer is free — because the more traders it holds, the more valuable it becomes to everyone.</p>
  1646→
  1647→    <div class="price-grid" style="max-width:380px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto">
  1648→      <div class="price-card featured">
  1649→        <div class="price-badge">Always free</div>
  1650→        <div class="price-tier">Every verified trader</div>
  1651→        <div class="price-n">KSh 0</div>
  1652→        <div class="price-who">Forever — no upgrade tier, no paywall</div>
  1653→        <ul class="price-list">
  1654→          <li>Verified public profile at plug.pay/yourname</li>
  1655→          <li>Unlimited sales recording &amp; floor-map listing</li>
  1656→          <li>Unlimited WhatsApp receipts</li>
  1657→          <li>Peer vouching &amp; receipt-anchored reviews</li>
  1658→          <li>Full trust-score building, from day one</li>

  1662→
  1663→    <p class="price-note" style="max-width:60ch">Our business is built on two things: the <strong style="color:#fff">delivery marketplace</strong> connecting buyers to verified runners, and <strong style="color:#fff">credit data</strong> - turning a trader's real transaction and vouching history into evidence sellers can use to get suppliers and financial institutions to safely extend stock credit or a loan.</p>

  1674→    <div class="t-card">

  1688→    <div class="eyebrow on-dark">The market focus</div>
  1689→    <h2>The trust layer for Kenya's digital commerce.</h2>
  1690→    <div class="market-sub">Commerce is moving faster than formal systems.</div>
  1691→    <p class="section-p">Social selling is exploding across WhatsApp, Instagram and Facebook Marketplace. Millions of traders sell every day without a shopfront, a website, or any way to prove they're real.</p>
  1692→
  1693→    <div class="check-list">
  1694→      <div class="check-item"><div class="check-icon">✓</div><span>Securing transactions between strangers on social media</span></div>
  1695→      <div class="check-item"><div class="check-icon">✓</div><span>No expensive developer integrations required for local vendors</span></div>
  1696→      <div class="check-item"><div class="check-icon">✓</div><span>Works over WhatsApp — no app download for buyers</span></div>
  1697→      <div class="check-item"><div class="check-icon">✓</div><span>Every sale becomes a verifiable, public track record</span></div>
  1698→    </div>
  1699→
  1700→    <div class="stat-callout">

  1702→      <div class="bt-l">Kenya's informal retail economy</div>
  1703→      <p>Estimated annual value moving through jua kali stalls and social-media traders with no formal trust layer today.</p>
  1704→    </div>
  1705→
  1706→    <div class="final-cta" id="final-cta">
  1707→      <h2>Ready to sell without the risk?</h2>
  1708→      <p class="section-p">PlugPay bridges the gap between a DM and a real sale. Join other verified traders building trust on WhatsApp today.</p>
  1709→      <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;justify-content:center">
  1710→        <button class="btn-mint" onclick="openOnboard()">I'm an agent →</button>
  1711→        <button class="btn-mint" style="background:transparent;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);color:#fff" onclick="openLandlordModal()">I own a building</button>
  1712→      </div>
  1713→    </div>
  1714→  </div>

  1717→<!-- ============ FAQ ============ -->
  1718→<section class="faq" id="faq">
  1719→  <div class="wrap">
  1720→    <div class="eyebrow">Common questions</div>
  1721→    <h2>Frequently asked questions</h2>
  1722→
  1723→    <details class="faq-item" open>
  1724→      <summary class="faq-q">What is PlugPay, in one line?<span class="faq-plus">+</span></summary>
  1725→      <div class="faq-a">PlugPay is trust infrastructure for Nairobi's informal traders — it turns years of reputation that used to live only in people's memory into something visible, provable, and portable. Every verified trader gets a public profile anchored to real ID, real sales, and real peer vouches. That proof travels with them even if the stall, the building, or the city block changes.</div>
  1726→    </details>
  1727→    <details class="faq-item">
  1728→      <summary class="faq-q">What's actually behind a trader's trust score?<span class="faq-plus">+</span></summary>
  1729→      <div class="faq-a">The platform is built in layers — verified identity, a peer vouching graph, a transaction ledger, public discovery, and payments — each one feeding the layer above it. A trust score isn't a single input; it's the compounding output of ID verification, landlord confirmation, peer vouches, and receipt-anchored reviews. The more of that history a trader has, the harder their profile is to fake.</div>
  1730→    </details>
  1731→    <details class="faq-item">
  1732→      <summary class="faq-q">Who is PlugPay actually built for?<span class="faq-plus">+</span></summary>
  1733→      <div class="faq-a">Three groups who currently deal blind: traders who can't prove years of honest dealing to a stranger, buyers who can't tell a legitimate seller from one who won't be there next month, and landlords whose buildings can't be marketed on reputation. PlugPay gives each the same underlying proof, just surfaced differently — a profile, a search result, a verified-building badge.</div>
  1734→    </details>
  1735→    <details class="faq-item">
  1736→      <summary class="faq-q">What can I actually do on PlugPay?<span class="faq-plus">+</span></summary>
  1737→      <div class="faq-a">Get verified once, then record every sale — manually or via a WhatsApp payment link — and an itemised receipt fires automatically to the buyer. Fellow traders and your landlord can vouch for you, and buyers can only review a sale that has a real receipt behind it. Your whole track record lives at one shareable link, and delivery runs through a built-in marketplace of verified runners.</div>
  1738→    </details>
  1739→    <details class="faq-item">
  1740→      <summary class="faq-q">How does an agent onboard a building?<span class="faq-plus">+</span></summary>
  1741→      <div class="faq-a">An agent signs in with an SMS or email OTP, then sets up an individual landlord account for the building — the landlord can log back into that account later to add more stall owners and complete monthly verification. The agent onboards the building and its stalls, and adds each stall owner's profile details, especially their phone number and email attached to their stall. Each stall owner then gets a claim link and signs up themselves with a WhatsApp OTP, with SMS as a fallback.</div>
  1742→    </details>
  1743→    <details class="faq-item">
  1744→      <summary class="faq-q">If it's free for traders, how does PlugPay make money?<span class="faq-plus">+</span></summary>
  1745→      <div class="faq-a">Not by charging traders — verification and unlimited receipts stay free, because the platform gets more valuable the more traders it holds. Revenue comes from the errand &amp; delivery marketplace and from turning trading history into credit data suppliers and lenders can act on. Traders get verified for free; PlugPay earns once that trust becomes something spendable.</div>
  1746→    </details>
  1747→  </div>
  1748→</section>
